notes_for_editor: Staffing and public access are unknown: no source read says who staffs Grassy now or whether visitors may climb it. Base material conflicts (concrete block per the register, cinder block per Forest Lookouts) and is unresolved. The Cibola Facebook post is undated in the cached copy, so the Bear Trap Fire has no year; date it if possible before publication. The July 2026 Grassy Fire in the Forest Service release is a different fire reported by the Withington lookout; the story flags it. A Facebook group post says the lookout was regularly staffed until the early 2000s; not used because it is an unverified member post. Record height_m 3.0 matches the 10-foot base, so it looks like cab-floor height; no change suggested.
